epoch_definition: One complete pass over the fixed training examples; for A3, remine with the full decoder before the next pass. An L-BFGS iteration is not an epoch.
best_metric: Fixed DEV full-decoder lemma+POS correct count; denominator must remain fixed
best_rule: Strict increase in DEV correct count and trainer safety checks pass; ties do not reset patience

overfitting.signal: TRAIN mean loss decreases AND DEV mean loss increases versus previous epoch AND DEV correct count is below best safe count

on_stop: Freeze and return the best safe checkpoint, including at E70 or patience exhaustion
A2: One calibration stage after the chosen A1/A3 checkpoint is frozen; CALIB only, no artificial epochs
TEST: Never used for early stopping, best-checkpoint choice or threshold tuning. The observed A123-v1 TEST is not a new unseen test for the next study.

backup.verify: SHA-256 for every artifact in both copies before committing state
backup.failure_policy: Stop safely on missing V drive, insufficient space or backup verification failure; never silently fall back to C

github.push_failure_policy: Keep the commit locally and retry on the next epoch or explicit sync; report unsynced state

integration.hook_required: Call EpochRun.complete_epoch with real full-pass metrics and complete weight/state artifacts; load the returned best checkpoint when stop is true
